_about: Voices shipped inside the installer (copied into the user's voice library on first use, see services/tts/voices.py). scripts/stage-installer.mjs takes each file from src-tauri/src-python/bin/Irodori-TTS-Server/voices and only includes entries with verified: true. Set verified only once you have checked that the voice's license allows redistributing the audio file itself; put the credit line its license asks for in `credit` (it goes into CREDITS.txt next to the voices).

voices.credit: Local voice cloned from ElevenLab's Haru

Ryosuke Sonobe, Shinnosuke Takamichi and Hiroshi Saruwatari,  "JSUT corpus: free large-scale Japanese speech corpus for end-to-end speech synthesis," arXiv preprint, 1711.00354, 2017. https://sites.google.com/site/shinnosuketakamichi/publication/jsut
